facts_copied.sanitization: curated, already-redacted excerpts of real, measured native transcripts. A handful of bulky tool or model text fields (thinking-block signature, tool input and output bodies, base_instructions) were shortened in place, every field the decoders read left unchanged. In the two E01 excerpts every real session id, message, turn and window UUID, msg_/req_/toolu_-prefixed API id and /Users/.../workspace path was replaced by a deterministic placeholder in one pass across both files, so the same original maps to the same placeholder: a bare UUID becomes 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<hex counter>; a msg_/req_/toolu_/ctc_/ctco_/fco_ id keeps its prefix with its suffix replaced by PLACEHOLDER<counter>; an E01 workspace path becomes /Users/placeholder/e01-workspace-<counter>. The source sha256 values are the raw sources', kept for provenance.
facts_copied.spike_sources: the two non-E01 source files are committed, sanitized spike fixtures in the old tree
facts_copied.redaction_audits: each excerpt had an empty *.redactions.jsonl audit file in the old crate (zero redactions)
